## Scope

`roboto_origin` is a daily-updated snapshot aggregation repository. Module-level code, hardware, model, training, deployment, firmware, navigation, and XR teleoperation changes should be proposed in the corresponding source sub-repository first.

Accepted here:
- root README / docs / links
- issue and PR templates
- repository metadata, license, or community files
- snapshot sync scripts and aggregation workflow fixes
- snapshot corrections that cannot be fixed upstream first

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR is limited to the aggregation layer, or explains why a direct snapshot fix is required.
- [ ] I did not edit `modules/...` for a change that should land in a source sub-repository first.
- [ ] Relevant links, paths, or module names are included in the PR description.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated when user-facing behavior or contribution flow changed.
